identity.excluded: PO2-, PO3-, PO, condensed phosphorus oxides; total atomization is not single-bond PO+O dissociation.

janaf_print.inspection: Numerical table and explanatory notes visually inspected.
janaf_print.uncertainty_definition: Historical estimate; no statistical confidence interpretation assigned.
janaf_print.energy_basis: Brewer and Rosenblatt 1961, DOI 10.1021/cr60211a003; estimated dissociation energy, not a new 1998 experiment. Original paper not inspected.
janaf_print.thermal_basis: Gordon 1960, Potter et al. 1960, Henderson and Scheffer 1960 estimates. Original reports not inspected.
janaf_print.reference_cycle_limit: The frozen source-balanced D0 is 1120.275 kJ/mol, whereas the note quotes an old estimate of 270 kcal/mol =1129.68 kJ/mol. The original 1962 atomic/reference cycle was not recovered; do not treat the note as an exact independent reconstruction of the current balanced tables.

PO2.reference: Gurvich 1989 volume 1 part 1 p408 and part 2 p260

nasa_inspection: NASA/TP-2002-211556 Appendix D neutral PO2/P/O headers and all printed NASA9 coefficients agree with the frozen baseline to displayed precision. Source formula uses R=8.31451 J/mol/K; baseline decomposition uses a common R=8.31446261815324. Gurvich book pages were not obtained.
reference_convention: NASA Appendix D explicitly labels P(cr) White, Ref-Elm. JANAF P(ref) has Hf298=0 and S298=41.077; existing phosphorus review identifies its white-P reference. Molecular Hf298 differences are not atomization differences. Each source is balanced with its own P/O gas atoms, including H298-H0, before comparison; no independent white/red-P offset is added.

cccbdb.uncertainty_definition: Listed database uncertainty; confidence level not established from the uninspected Gurvich discussion.
cccbdb.ancestry: All these thermochemical/excited-level entries cite Gurvich; not independent evidence for NASA.

chen2023.inspection: Full open-access paper available; relevant methods, Table 3 (printed p10649/PDF p7), discussion and references inspected; Table 3 visually checked.
chen2023.scope: Ground-state PO2 X2A1 global MRCI(Q) CHIPR PES and P+O2 reaction dynamics, not a complete thermal-state partition model.
chen2023.caveat: Table 3 juxtaposes an electronic PES well with experimental D0 and ZPE-corrected theory. These numbers are not all De or all D0. Older values are quotations checked in Chen, not direct inspection of those original papers.

decision.production: Retain inherited curated fit provisionally in this source-only review.
decision.preferred_direction: Re-evaluate the binding energy toward the weaker binding indicated by later experiment/theory, using a source-consistent atomization anchor. NASA/Gurvich is a concrete diagnostic candidate, not established as the best final model. Audit the thermal function separately against modern spectroscopy.
decision.why_no_adoption: The quantified 1962 estimate and obsolete thermal inputs justify follow-up, but later cited D0/theory differ and the complete source conventions and state sum have not yet been evaluated. No full replacement or abundance substitution has been tested.
decision.scope_completion: Initial source investigation is complete with MCEG follow-ups; these remaining scientific questions do not block merging this evidence-only record.
